header: // Shared mini-app response envelopes. Every endpoint answers JSON, so the
// two constructors live in one place instead of being repeated per handler.
// Mini App authentication. initData is an HMAC-SHA256 over the raw query
// string keyed by a secret derived from the bot token ("WebAppData") —
// verified exactly as Telegram specifies, including the 1-hour freshness
// bound. Nothing in the Mini App is reachable without passing this.
// Self-service user endpoints: profile, usage counters, the Mini App chat
// box (which runs the real provider pipeline, not a stub), the model picker
// and the coding-mode switch.
// Per-user personal model connections, gated by the admin-controlled
// `personal_models_allowed` setting and the per-user limit.
// Route (multi-model failover bundle) CRUD shared by the self-service view
// and the admin panel; both call the same handlers with the admin's user id.
// Admin panel endpoints: site stats, user/chat pagination, global settings
// and per-connection usage metrics. Reachability is enforced once, in the
// router, before any of these run.
// Broadcast management over the admin API: create, list, pause/resume,
// cancel, and per-broadcast delivery stats.
// Failed-update (dead-letter) inspection and replay. Only useful because the
// queue consumer now actually persists failures — see `logFailedUpdate` in
// src/index.js.
// The Mini App's HTTP surface: one flat route table over `pathname`, with a
// single authentication gate (and a separate admin gate) applied before any
// handler runs. Kept as one table so the API contract is readable in one
// place — the handlers themselves are grouped by domain in sibling files.
extraImports: import { handleUserProfile, handleUserStats, handleChatMessage, handleUserConnections, handleSetActiveConnection, handleToggleCodingMode } from "./user.js";
import { handleUserRoutes, handleAdminCreateRoute, handleAdminDeleteRoute, handleAdminRouteAction } from "./routes.js";
import { handleAdminStats, handleAdminUsers, handleAdminChats, handleAdminSettings, handleAdminUpdateSettings } from "./admin.js";
import { handleAdminBroadcasts, handleCreateBroadcast, handleBroadcastAction, handleGetBroadcast } from "./broadcast-api.js";
